item.title: Outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouts; people sickened with E. coli and Salmonella
item.description: CDC warns of a multistate Salmonella and E. coli outbreak linked to recalled alfalfa sprout product.

item.title: CDC warns of Salmonella outbreak linked to jalapenos
item.description: A CDC food safety alert regarding a multistate outbreak of Salmonella linked to jalapenos.

item.title: CDC Encourages Americans to Stay Mosquito Bite-Free during holiday weekend
item.description: CDC: Early West Nile season brings record cases; protect against mosquito bites this holiday weekend. West Nile virus is spread by mosquito bites.
